subject: Post-demo: model fit, eval plan & structured-output (function-calling) next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: model fit, eval plan & structured-output (function-calling) next steps

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the context on your ingestion pipelines and the examples you shared for structured invoice extraction. Quick recap with suggested next steps so we can align on an eval plan:

- Summary of fit: your use case (structured invoice parsing + downstream entity normalization) looks like a strong fit for a trimmed-generation + function-calling flow where we enforce a JSON schema for downstream systems.
- Recommended models: start with Llama-2-13B-v2-quant (fast inference, good structural coherence) and Redwood-Open-34B for higher-quality schema-complete outputs in corner cases. We'll run both in the eval to measure schema compliance vs cost/latency.
- Benchmarks & artifacts shared: attached is a short benchmark summary (redwood_benchmark_summary.pdf) showing schema compliance rates across similar customers; prompt sets for your examples are attached as acme_prompt_sets_v1.csv.

Primary asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the sample size we should use for the eval (e.g., 200 invoices, or a stratified 500)?
2) Please share any strict JSON schema(s) you must enforce (example keys, required fields). If you only have example outputs, that’s fine — we can derive a schema and iterate.
3) I'll coordinate with our Eval team to run tool/function-calling tests with retries/backoff enabled and structural validation (we'll capture false-positive/false-negative schema failures).

I'll set up a shared Drive folder with the prompt sets and initial evaluation plan. Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync next Tues to align on sample selection and security/hosting (VPC preferred?).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_summary.pdf (summary), acme_prompt_sets_v1.csv (prompt examples)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan@acmeanalytics.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model fit, eval plan & structured-output (function-calling) next steps

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A few quick answers and questions:

- Sample size: procurement wants to see a smaller pilot first. Can we start with 200 invoices (random sample) and then expand to 1,000 if results look good?
- JSON schema: we have an internal schema for our invoice indexer. I'll attach the canonical schema in the next message from Priya (she owns the indexing team).
- Hosting: we'd prefer Private (VPC) for the pilot due to PII. Can you confirm Redwood supports VPC deployments for evals? Also need to understand how retries with function-calling will be logged/audited.

Also, cost sensitivity — we need a rough ballpark per-1k-token cost for both the 13B quant and the 34B variants you suggested. Can you put those in the eval plan so procurement has something to review?

Jordan

Please bake in a normalization prompt + explicit schema enforcement step in the eval harness; capture where model required a second call or post-processing to be compliant.

Subject: Invoice JSON schema (canonical)

Hi Marissa & Jordan — attaching the canonical schema and a small sample set (20 invoices) to kick off. We'll expand to 200 once procurement signs off on the pilot. A couple of notes:

- Required fields: invoice_id, vendor_name, invoice_date (ISO8601), total_amount (number), currency, line_items (array of {description, qty, unit_price, amount}). Metadata keys should be optional but consistent.
- Validation strictness: we need structural compliance on required fields and types. Minor formatting differences (e.g., currency string casing) are okay; missing required fields or wrong types are blockers.

Marissa — can you confirm you'll enable the structured-output validator and include logs showing retry counts and post-processing corrections? Also include a sample failure report format so we can evaluate risk.

Thanks,
Priya

Attachments: acme_invoice_schema.json (canonical schema), acme_sample_20.zip (20 sample invoices)
